scripts.title: Touch of death
scripts.script:
local cooldown = 0
local active = true 
local runService = game:GetService("RunService")

local function superPunch()
    local args = {
        [1] = "Punch",
        [2] = {
            ["SuperPunch"] = true
        }
    }

    
    game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").RemoteEvents.VampireEvent:FireServer(unpack(args))
end

runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if active then
        superPunch()
        wait(cooldown)
    end
end)

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local mouse = player:GetMouse()

mouse.Button2Down:Connect(function()
    active = not active
end)
